text: The watch is quite good overall. For a piece that is not stainless steel, it still presents itself well. It arrived properly protected, including both the watch and the clasp.    The strap feels very soft and well made, which is uncommon. Although it is marked as leather, I am not fully convinced it is genuine. The clasp is also solid and well constructed. It is a decent integrated strap system with fixed prongs and worth keeping.    The crystal is domed and there is no AR coating. The case brushing is nicely done and nothing feels rough or cheaply finished. The caseback is also well executed. The movement appears simple and unbranded. It does not look poorly finished, though I am unsure if it is a Seagull ST or another clone.    It was demagnetized on arrival and the initial measurements were acceptable, although it will likely take about a week for stable readings. At the moment it is running about 33 seconds slow, which is acceptable for now, and the amplitude looks good.

When I used the power bank for the very first time, it was 74% battery. I used it charge few devices then dropped to 40%. From 40% onwards it discharged until 0 almost like a stopwatch. However, this rapid discharge has only happened once so far. Overall, the product is acceptable.
